routes.note: Routes are values of state.page (go(page)); there is no URL router or hash routing in the draft. Unknown values render no page; page "account" renders the sign-in page while signed out. WordPress slugs are in the draft manifest.

toggling_sc_ifs.note: sc-ifs whose value depends on interactive or input state (menus, drawers, accordions, tabs, steps, modes, results, cart, account state).

other_sc_ifs.note: Totals reconcile: Eye Care Birmingham: 79 toggling + 11 route + 7 breakpoint + 29 content_variant = 126; Frame Card: 0 toggling + 8 content_variant = 8; WP Build Gap Map: 1 toggling + 1 content_variant = 2.

unresolved.reason: state.page is not reflected in the URL; back/forward and deep links do not work in the prototype. Production routes come from the draft manifest.
